Who we are

10+

The Foundation Behind Every Fabric.

Samruddhi Industries is a large scale manufacturer of Muslin and Rayon greige fabrics, producing the base fabric that becomes the foundation for countless textile applications. With extensive manufacturing capacity, diverse fabric capabilities and integrated production, we deliver consistent greige fabric at the scale the industry demands.
